title: Nutrient-management effects on projected hypoxia
query: Evaluate how nutrient reduction changes projected coastal hypoxia in the supplied Pearl River estuary–shelf simulations under SSP5-8.5. Compare ConstantN and DecreasingN during 2016–2045 and 2071–2100 using hypoxic water volume, quantify between-period changes and interannual variability, and assess whether the management effect persists in the later period.
